level2.name: Sample Count

params.n_samples: Initial number of full application samples, default 80000
params.applied_sample: 1 outputs all applications; 0 outputs only approved samples

rules: When applied_sample=0, the final output is about n_samples * approve_rate rows
When applied_sample=0, is_approved is all 1 in the output data

params.observation_timestamp: Observation date; when empty, today 00:00 is used
params.application_months: Number of months the application time looks back, default 18

params.num_online_scores: Number of online_model_pb_1 ... online_model_pb_n to generate, default 5

level2.name: Performance Labels

params.y_flag_candidates: List of days for generating y_flag_dpd7_in_{days}d, default [15,30,45]

rules: Performance labels are generated only for approved samples; unapproved samples are empty
Only samples with apply_timestamp + days <= observation_timestamp are mature
Force a check that the mature count of short-term labels is greater than that of long-term labels

level2.name: Random Features

params.num_features: Number of randomly generated features, default 20
params.min_num_feature_business_type: Minimum number of business types the features must cover, default 5

rules: When num_features>0, min_num_feature_business_type must be between 1 and min(num_features,10)
feature_metadata records the field names, business types, and distributions

requirement_note: All MockSamplePipeline configuration has defaults, so there is no required configuration; it is still advisable to confirm the sample size and output scope as the business needs.

approval_flag.meaning: Approved samples are taken in ascending order of latent risk (low risk first)

y_flags.meaning: Only approved and mature samples get a 0/1 label

features.meaning: Generates random features by business type and outputs feature_metadata
